description: Discard a draft that listing_create saved without photos: it leaves drafts_awaiting_photos, its finish_url no longer opens it, and listing_add_photos can no longer finish it. Only this account's own connector drafts can be discarded. A draft cannot be edited, so to change one (a new price, say) discard it and create the listing again. Without confirmed: true nothing changes and the draft is described back.

confirmed.description: false: nothing changes, and the result says what would. true: discard it, once the seller has agreed.

draft_id.description: A draft_id from listing_create or from drafts_awaiting_photos in seller_list_listings.

name: listing_discard_draft
title: Discard a draft
